design_philosophy: A minimalist, fresh SaaS POS dashboard for BolsonesControl. Avoids cliché greengrocer themes by utilizing an elegant, pale stone and sage palette mixed with sharp, high-contrast dark text and distinct state colors. Emphasizes clean typography, generous padding on structural elements, and a dense, functional layout for POS/Kanban views.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing for layout skeleton (p-6, p-8) and dense, functional spacing for POS tables and forms (p-4).
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-gray-200 bg-white h-screen fixed hidden md:block
layout_and_spacing.mobile_nav: md:hidden bottom-0 fixed w-full bg-white border-t border-gray-200 z-50
layout_and_spacing.header: h-16 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 z-40 flex items-center px-6 justify-between
layout_and_spacing.main_content: md:ml-64 p-6 sm:p-8 min-h-screen pb-20 md:pb-8

surface_styles.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg p-6
surface_styles.pos_panel: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col h-full
surface_styles.scale_display: bg-gray-50 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-6 text-center shadow-inner

components.badges: Use rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border for all state indicators.
components.buttons: Primary buttons should use the primary color with hover state. Include icons where relevant (lucide-react).
components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned text, right-aligned numerical data (prices/weights). Subtle border-b on rows.
components.kanban_board: Horizontal scrollable container with vertical columns for each state. Cards inside columns should have a slight hover lift (-translate-y-1).
components.dialogs: Use Shadcn dialog for Modals like 'Generación de etiquetas' and 'Pagar/Caja'. Keep max-w-md or max-w-lg to avoid stretching.
components.scale_sim: Use a digital LCD style (JetBrains Mono) for the simulated weight. Include a tare (Tara) button.

animation_and_interaction.hover: Subtle background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-gray-50) and shadow increases (hover:shadow-md) on interactive cards.
animation_and_interaction.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for general UI elements.

icons.instructions: Use consistent stroke-width (usually 2 or 1.5). Match icon color to text color context.

images.category: Public Order Form Hero / Auth Background
images.description: Minimal fresh green and red fruit with green leaves, suitable for a login screen background or public form hero.
Clean sliced vegetables, can be used as a subtle banner or empty state illustration.
Modern POS setup to serve as an abstract background or placeholder in settings/staff areas.

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select, links, metric cards) MUST have a data-testid attribute using kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='pos-scan-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the project with the specified color palette and tailwind settings.
2. Add fonts Outfit (headings) and IBM Plex Sans (body) from Google Fonts.
3. Set up the exact screens requested: Login, Dashboard, Stock, Compras, Armado de bolsones, POS/Caja, Pedidos Kanban, Clientes, Mermas, Empleados, Reportes, Configuración, and Public Order Form.
4. Use the specific state colors (Disponible, Reservado, Vendido, etc.) via Shadcn badges or colored text indicators.
5. For 'Armado de bolsones', build a 'Balanza Simulada' using the JetBrains Mono font for the weight display, along with a UI mock for generating QR/barcode labels.
6. Build a Kanban view for 'Pedidos' with columns clearly colored using the state variables provided.
7. Implement strict usage of data-testid on every interactive component.
8. Use lucide-react for all iconography to maintain a clean, fresh look.
